label: Save button tooltip
summary: The tooltip text of the Save button in the ruler designer.
details: The ruler designer is the screen where the player creates a custom character. Vanilla sets this tooltip on both Save buttons, next to CanOpenSaveRulerWindow, which turns the button on or off. Going by that pairing, the text says whether saving is possible right now.

label: Can pick trait
summary: Whether the given trait can be picked for the character in the ruler designer.
details: Takes a trait. Vanilla turns each trait button of the trait picker on or off with it.

label: Trait pick tooltip
summary: The tooltip text of a trait button in the ruler designer's trait picker, for the given trait.
details: Takes a trait. Going by its name and its place next to CanPickTrait, it says why the trait can or cannot be picked.

label: Stop editing traits
summary: Ends the editing of a trait slot in the ruler designer without picking a trait.
details: Vanilla calls it from the Done button of the trait picker, which also closes the picker.

label: Change daughter count
summary: Raises or lowers the number of daughters generated for the designed ruler, by the given amount.
details: Takes a whole number. Vanilla's minus and plus buttons pass -1 and 1.

label: Change son count
summary: Raises or lowers the number of sons generated for the designed ruler, by the given amount.
details: Takes a whole number. Vanilla's minus and plus buttons pass -1 and 1.

label: Close ruler designer
summary: Closes the ruler designer.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button of the ruler designer window.

label: Finalize character
summary: Finishes the ruler designer and applies the designed character; the game warns that this cannot be undone.
details: Vanilla calls it from the Finalize button, which is only enabled when CanFinalize allows it. The game's confirmation text says the change cannot be undone once submitted. Going by the names of this function and GetCharacterToOverwrite, the designed character takes the place of the existing one.

label: Finish dynasty arms
summary: Finishes customizing the coat of arms of the designed ruler's dynasty.
details: Vanilla calls it from the FINISH button (tooltip "Finish Customizing Dynasty"), shown while the dynasty's coat of arms is being edited. The same button also closes the editor panel.

label: Finish title arms
summary: Finishes customizing the coat of arms of the designed ruler's title.
details: Vanilla calls it from the FINISH button (tooltip "Finish Customizing Title"), shown while the title's coat of arms is being edited. The same button also closes the editor panel.

label: Pick trait
summary: Picks the given trait for the slot being edited in the ruler designer.
details: Takes a trait. Vanilla calls it when a trait button in the trait picker is clicked; the button is only enabled when CanPickTrait allows it.

label: Accessory options
summary: The list of choices for an accessory gene (such as hair or beard) in the ruler designer's appearance editor.
details: Takes a gene category. Vanilla shows it as a list of buttons under accessory genes only. The game documents no return type.

label: Age
summary: The age of the character in the ruler designer, in years.
details: Vanilla shows it as "N Years" and feeds it to the age slider.

label: Birth year
summary: The year the character in the ruler designer was born.
details: Vanilla shows it as "Born: year AD".

label: Ruler to replace
summary: Going by its name, the existing character that the designed character will overwrite.
details: Vanilla reads that character's primary title from it, for the realm shown in the designer and for the title name. The game documents no return type.

label: Coat of arms editor
summary: The coat of arms editor built into the ruler designer.
details: Vanilla fills the coat of arms editing panel from it. The game documents no return type.

label: Culture
summary: The culture picked for the character in the ruler designer.
details: Vanilla shows its name, for example in the button text "Random <culture> Ethnicity". The game documents no return type.

label: Faith difference breakdown
summary: Going by its name, a breakdown (a detail tooltip) of the divergence of the given faith.
details: Takes a faith (a rite in the game's code). Vanilla uses it as the data source of an icon in the part of a faith row that is shown for heresies. What exactly it breaks down is not documented. The game documents no return type.

label: Dynasty coat of arms
summary: The coat of arms of the designed ruler's dynasty.
details: Vanilla shows it in the dynasty part of the ruler designer, next to the button that opens the coat of arms editor. The game documents no return type.

label: Dynasty name
summary: The dynasty name entered for the character in the ruler designer.
details: Vanilla shows it in the edit field and in the character's full name.

label: Ethnicity
summary: The ethnicity (a group of looks used for portraits) picked for the character in the ruler designer.
details: Vanilla shows its name and marks the matching button in the ethnicity list. The game documents no return type.

label: Finalize tooltip
summary: The tooltip text of the ruler designer's Finalize button.
details: Vanilla sets it on the Finalize button, next to CanFinalize, which turns the button on or off. Going by that pairing, the text says whether the character can be finalized.

label: First name
summary: The first name entered for the character in the ruler designer.
details: Vanilla shows it in the edit field and in the character's full name, and hides parts of the window while it is empty.

label: Gene groups
summary: The list of gene groups (body part tabs such as head and neck) of the ruler designer's appearance editor.
details: Vanilla builds the list of appearance tabs from it. The game documents no return type.

label: Genes of group
summary: The genes of one gene group in the ruler designer's appearance editor.
details: Takes the group's name; vanilla passes the name of the appearance tab that is open. The game documents no return type.

label: Health icon frame
summary: A whole number of the ruler designer that, going by its name, picks the frame of a health icon.
details: Vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Health text
summary: A text of the ruler designer that, going by its name, describes the designed character's health.
details: Vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Gene slider value
summary: The current value of the given shape gene (a slider such as nose width) in the ruler designer.
details: Takes a gene category. Vanilla puts it on the gene's slider and shows it as a number.

label: Gene presets
summary: The list of preset shapes (templates) for the given shape gene in the ruler designer.
details: Takes a gene category. Vanilla only shows the preset buttons when this list has more than one entry. The game documents no return type.

label: Number of children
summary: How many children in all are generated for the designed ruler.
details: Vanilla disables the plus buttons for sons and daughters once this reaches CalcMaxNumberOfGeneratedChildren.

label: Number of daughters
summary: How many daughters are generated for the designed ruler.
details: The game's tooltip calls them daughters of the ruler's culture and faith. Vanilla disables the minus button at 0.

label: Number of sons
summary: How many sons are generated for the designed ruler.
details: The game's tooltip calls them sons of the ruler's culture and faith. Vanilla disables the minus button at 0.

label: Points used
summary: How many ruler designer points the designed character uses.
details: Vanilla compares it with the define NRulerDesigner IRONMAN_POINT_MAX and shows different parts of the window at or below that value and above it. Going by the name, that define is the point limit for Ironman games.

label: Points breakdown
summary: The breakdown of what the designed character's points are spent on.
details: Vanilla shows it in the points part of the ruler designer. The game documents no return type.

label: Portrait image
summary: The picture of the designed character, drawn with the given scene, camera and size.
details: Takes three values: the portrait environment (such as 'environment_body'), the camera (such as 'camera_ruler_designer') and the size in pixels (such as '(CVector2f)650,1100'). Vanilla uses it for the full body view and the head views.

fields.name: environment
fields.values: an environment name, such as 'environment_body' or 'environment_head'

fields.name: camera
fields.text: The camera the portrait is drawn with.

label: Faith
summary: The faith picked for the character in the ruler designer.
details: The game's code calls a faith a rite here. Vanilla reads the faith's details from it and disables the button of the faith already picked. The game documents no return type.

label: Selected culture
summary: Going by its name, the culture selected in the ruler designer.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. CoatOfArmsDesigner.GetSelectedCulture is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Title adjective
summary: The adjective entered for the designed ruler's title in the ruler designer.
details: Vanilla shows it in a text field of the title customization.

label: Title coat of arms
summary: The coat of arms of the designed ruler's primary title.
details: Vanilla shows it in the realm part of the ruler designer, hidden for landless characters. The game documents no return type.

label: Title map color
summary: The map color chosen for the designed ruler's title.
details: A color with four parts (red, green, blue, alpha). Vanilla shows it in the color picker of the title customization.

label: Title name
summary: The name entered for the designed ruler's title.
details: Vanilla shows it alone or as "<tier> of <name>", depending on TitleUsesDefiniteForm.

label: Title rank word
summary: The tier name of the designed ruler's title (its rank word), put before the name.
details: Vanilla uses it at the start of the character's full name in the ruler designer. Going by its name and that use, it is the tier name of the title.

label: Weight
summary: The weight setting of the character in the ruler designer.
details: Vanilla puts it on the weight slider and shows it as a whole number.

label: Has accessory genes
summary: Whether the ruler designer has accessory genes (the hair and beard options) for the character.
details: Vanilla only shows the "Show Hair and Beard" toggle when this is true.

label: Has house motto
summary: Whether a house motto has been entered in the ruler designer.
details: While it is false, vanilla shows the hint that a random motto is made on finalizing.

label: Preset is picked
summary: Whether the given preset shape is the one picked in the ruler designer.
details: Takes a gene template. Vanilla shows the matching preset button as pressed.

label: Has sexuality
summary: Whether the character in the ruler designer has the given sexuality.
details: Takes a sexuality name such as 'none' or 'heterosexual'. Vanilla shows the matching button as pressed.

label: Has trait
summary: Whether the character in the ruler designer already has the given trait.
details: Takes a trait. Vanilla hides traits from the picker that the character already has.

label: Hide faith list entries
summary: Going by its name and its use, hides all entries of the ruler designer's faith list.
details: Vanilla calls it when an animation starts, right after hiding the religion list's entries. What it is for is not documented.

label: Is adult
summary: Whether the character in the ruler designer is an adult at the age set.
details: Vanilla shows or enables some parts of the window only for adults and others only for children.

label: Appearance from choices on
summary: Whether the ruler designer generates the appearance from the choices made.
details: Vanilla shows it as the checkbox "Generate Appearance from selection"; ToggleAppearanceOverride switches it. What counts as the choices is not documented.

label: Is designing landless
summary: Whether the ruler designer is making a landless character instead of a ruler.
details: Vanilla then calls the window "Character Designer" instead of "Ruler Designer" and hides the title parts.

label: Is female
summary: Whether the character in the ruler designer is female.
details: Vanilla shows the female or male button as pressed according to it.

label: Accessory option valid
summary: Whether the given accessory choice can be offered in the ruler designer.
details: Takes a portrait modifier of the ruler designer. Vanilla hides the accessory buttons for which this is false; when a choice counts as valid is not documented.

label: Gene only for women
summary: Whether the given gene only shows on female characters.
details: Takes a gene category. Vanilla shows the note "Only visible for women" on the gene's slider when it is true.

label: Accessory option picked
summary: Whether the given accessory choice is the one picked for the given gene in the ruler designer.
details: Takes a gene category and a portrait modifier of the ruler designer. Vanilla shows the matching button as pressed.

label: Paste DNA
summary: Gives the character in the ruler designer the looks stored in a DNA text on the clipboard.
details: Vanilla calls it from the Paste DNA button. If the text is not valid DNA, the game shows a "Paste DNA Failed" message.

label: Age slider moved
summary: Sets the character's age in the ruler designer from the age slider.
details: Takes the slider widget. Vanilla calls it whenever the slider's value changes.

label: Dynasty name edited
summary: Takes over the dynasty name typed into the ruler designer's dynasty name field.
details: Vanilla calls it whenever the field's text is edited.

label: First name edited
summary: Takes over the first name typed into the ruler designer's name field.
details: Vanilla calls it whenever the field's text is edited.

label: House motto edited
summary: Takes over the house motto typed into the ruler designer's motto field.
details: Vanilla calls it whenever the field's text is edited. If no motto is entered, the game makes a random one on finalizing.

label: Title adjective edited
summary: Takes over the title adjective typed into the ruler designer's title customization.
details: Vanilla calls it whenever the field's text is edited.

label: Title name edited
summary: Takes over the title name typed into the ruler designer's title customization.
details: Vanilla calls it whenever the field's text is edited.

label: Gene slider moved
summary: Sets the value of the given shape gene from its slider in the ruler designer.
details: Takes the gene category and the slider widget. Vanilla calls it whenever the slider's value changes.

label: Pick gene preset
summary: Picks the given preset shape for its gene in the ruler designer.
details: Takes a gene template. Vanilla calls it when a preset button is clicked.

label: Pick accessory option
summary: Picks the given accessory choice for the given gene in the ruler designer.
details: Takes a gene category and a portrait modifier of the ruler designer. Vanilla calls it when an accessory button is clicked.

label: Weight slider moved
summary: Sets the character's weight in the ruler designer from the weight slider.
details: Takes the slider widget. Vanilla calls it whenever the slider's value changes.

label: Edit dynasty arms
summary: Opens the coat of arms editor for the designed ruler's dynasty.
details: Vanilla calls it from the edit button next to the dynasty's coat of arms.

label: Open load window
summary: Opens the window for loading a ruler saved from the ruler designer.
details: Vanilla calls it from two Load buttons of the ruler designer.

label: Open save window
summary: Opens the window for saving the designed ruler to a file.
details: Vanilla calls it from the two Save buttons; CanOpenSaveRulerWindow decides whether they are enabled.

label: Edit title arms
summary: Opens the coat of arms editor for the designed ruler's title.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button of the ruler designer.

label: Random dynasty name
summary: Gives the designed ruler's dynasty a random name.
details: Vanilla calls it from the "Randomize Dynasty Name" button.

label: Random looks from culture
summary: Gives the character in the ruler designer random looks of an ethnicity of the picked culture.
details: Vanilla calls it from the "Randomize Appearance" button and then refreshes the portrait. Going by its name, the new looks come from an ethnicity of the picked culture.

label: Random looks from ethnicity
summary: Gives the character in the ruler designer new random looks of the ethnicity picked now.
details: Vanilla calls it from a "Randomize Appearance" button of the appearance editor and refreshes the portrait. Going by its name, it keeps the current ethnicity.

label: Random culture name
summary: Gives the character in the ruler designer a random first name of the picked culture.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button whose tooltip is "Random <culture> Name".

label: Random faith name
summary: Gives the character in the ruler designer a random first name of the picked faith.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button whose tooltip is "Random <faith adjective> Name".

label: Reset title
summary: Undoes the title customization in the ruler designer and goes back to the title's historical name and look.
details: Vanilla calls it from the "Reset Title to Historical" button, hidden for landless characters.

label: Copy DNA
summary: Copies the looks of the character in the ruler designer to the clipboard as DNA text.
details: Vanilla calls it from the Copy DNA button; the text can be pasted into another character.

label: Window itself
summary: A function on the ruler designer that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. In game texts Self follows other things, for example Character.Self passed as an argument; those lines belong to other types and are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Set culture
summary: Picks the given culture for the character in the ruler designer.
details: Takes a culture. Vanilla calls it from the culture buttons of the culture picker.

label: Set ethnicity
summary: Picks the given ethnicity for the character in the ruler designer.
details: Takes an ethnicity. Vanilla calls it from the ethnicity list and refreshes the portrait.

label: Set sex
summary: Makes the character in the ruler designer female or male.
details: Takes yes or no: '(bool)yes' makes her female, '(bool)no' makes him male.

label: Set faith
summary: Picks the given faith for the character in the ruler designer.
details: Takes a faith (a rite in the game's code). Vanilla calls it from the faith buttons.

label: Set sexuality
summary: Gives the character in the ruler designer the given sexuality.
details: Takes a sexuality name: 'none', 'heterosexual', 'homosexual' and so on, one button each.

label: Show accessories
summary: Going by its name, turns on showing hair and beard on the ruler designer's portrait.
details: Vanilla calls it from the button that opens the ethnicity tab in the full body view. ToggleShowAccessories is the checkbox version; going by their names, this one only turns the display on instead of switching it.

label: Set title map color
summary: Takes over the map color chosen for the designed ruler's title.
details: Vanilla calls it when the color is changed in the title customization's color picker.

label: Will get spouse
summary: Whether the designed ruler starts married.
details: The game's tooltip says the spouse shares the ruler's culture and faith. Vanilla shows it as a checkbox.

label: Shows hair and beard
summary: Whether the ruler designer's portrait shows the chosen hair and beard.
details: The game's own name has a typo (Acesssories); it must be written that way. Hidden hair and beard are still applied on finalizing.

label: Show gene slider
summary: Whether the given shape gene gets a slider in the ruler designer.
details: Takes a gene category. Vanilla shows one layout for shape genes when it is true and another when it is false.

label: Title uses definite form
summary: Whether the designed ruler's title is named by its name alone instead of "<tier> of <name>".
details: Vanilla shows it as a checkbox in the title customization.

label: Toggle appearance from choices
summary: Switches on or off whether the ruler designer generates the appearance from the choices made.
details: Vanilla calls it from the "Generate Appearance from selection" checkbox.

label: Toggle spouse
summary: Switches whether the designed ruler starts married or unmarried.
details: Vanilla calls it from the married checkbox.

label: Toggle hair and beard
summary: Switches showing the chosen hair and beard on the ruler designer's portrait on or off.
details: Only changes the portrait; they are still applied on finalizing.

label: Toggle definite form
summary: Switches whether the designed ruler's title is named by its name alone or as "<tier> of <name>".
details: Vanilla calls it from the definite form checkbox of the title customization.

label: Access advice itself
summary: A function on a ruler objective advice that, going by its name, hands back the advice itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Description
summary: The description text of a piece of advice for the player's ruler objective.
details: Vanilla shows it in the ruler objective panel of the main screen and on map icons.

label: Relevance
summary: How relevant a piece of ruler objective advice is, as a number.
details: Vanilla shows it as "(Rel: N)". How the number is worked out is not documented.

label: Summary
summary: The short summary text of a piece of advice for the player's ruler objective.
details: Vanilla shows it in the ruler objective panel of the main screen and on map icons.

label: Title
summary: Going by its name, the title that a piece of ruler objective advice is about.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of the elements in the ruler objective panel and on map icons. Whether it is a landed title or something else is not documented. The game documents no return type.

label: Is being done
summary: Whether the player is already carrying out a piece of ruler objective advice.
details: Vanilla shows different parts of the ruler objective panel depending on it. Going by its name and that use.

label: Advice itself
summary: A function on a ruler objective advice that, going by its name, hands back the advice itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. In game texts Self follows other things, for example Character.Self passed as an argument; those lines belong to other types and are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access icon itself
summary: A function on a map icon of ruler objective advice that, going by its name, hands back the icon itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Advice
summary: The ruler objective advice a map icon stands for.
details: Vanilla reads the advice's texts and title from it on the map icon layer.

label: Icon itself
summary: A function on a map icon of ruler objective advice that, going by its name, hands back the icon itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. In game texts Self follows other things, for example Character.Self passed as an argument; those lines belong to other types and are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access entry itself
summary: A function on an activity entry of the AI debug window that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Priority
summary: The AI's priority score for an activity type, as text.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, where it is shown as "Priority:". The same entry also leads to a breakdown of why the AI would host the activity.

label: Activity type
summary: The activity type an entry of the AI watch window is about.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, to show the type's name and to start a calculation of values for that activity.

label: Entry itself
summary: The activity entry of the AI watch window itself.
details: Vanilla passes it to AIWatchWindow.AccessAIWillHostBreakdownTooltip, for the breakdown of why the AI would host the activity. The game documents no return type.

label: Access entry itself
summary: A function on an activity location entry of the AI debug window that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Work out phases
summary: Going by its name, works out the AI's scores for the phases of an activity at this location.
details: Only used by a button of the AI watch window, a debug tool.

label: Location
summary: The province an activity location entry of the AI watch window is about.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, to show the province's name.

label: Weight
summary: The AI's weight for an activity location entry, as text.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, where it is shown as "Weight:".

label: Entry itself
summary: The activity location entry of the AI watch window itself.
details: Vanilla passes it to AIWatchWindow.AccessValueBreakdownForActivityProvince, for the breakdown of the location's weight. The game documents no return type.

label: Access entry itself
summary: A function on an activity option entry of the AI debug window that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Option category
summary: The category of an activity option entry of the AI watch window.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, to show the category's name.

label: Weight
summary: The AI's weight for an activity option entry, as text.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, where it is shown as "Weight:".

label: Activity option
summary: The activity option an entry of the AI watch window is about.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, to show the option's name.

label: Entry itself
summary: The activity option entry of the AI watch window itself.
details: Vanilla passes it to AIWatchWindow.AccessValueBreakdownForActivityOption, for the breakdown of the option's weight. The game documents no return type.

label: Access entry itself
summary: A function on an activity phase entry of the AI debug window that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Activity phase
summary: The activity phase an entry of the AI watch window is about.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, to show the phase's name and whether it is predefined.

label: Weight
summary: The AI's weight for an activity phase entry, as text.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, as "Weight:"; for a predefined phase the window shows "-predefined-" instead.

label: Entry itself
summary: The activity phase entry of the AI watch window itself.
details: Vanilla passes it to AIWatchWindow.AccessValueBreakdownForActivityPhase, for the breakdown of the phase's weight. The game documents no return type.

label: Access entry itself
summary: A function on a casus belli entry of the AI debug window that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Casus belli type
summary: The casus belli (war reason) type an entry of the AI watch window is about.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool.

label: Claimant
summary: The claimant character of a casus belli entry in the AI watch window.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, as the portrait of the claimant; the portrait is clickable (OnClickClaimant). Which claim is meant is not documented.

label: Highest power ratio
summary: The maximum military power ratio of a casus belli entry in the AI watch window.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, as the second number of "Power Ratio (Actual/Max)". What the maximum is used for is not documented.

label: Military power
summary: The military power value of a casus belli entry in the AI watch window.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, as "Military Power:". Whose power it is is not shown.

label: Power ratio
summary: The actual military power ratio of a casus belli entry in the AI watch window.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, as the first number of "Power Ratio (Actual/Max)". Between which sides the ratio is taken is not documented.

label: Score
summary: The AI's score for a casus belli entry, as text.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, as "Score:". GetScoreTooltip is the tooltip shown with it.

label: Score tooltip
summary: The tooltip text of a casus belli entry's score in the AI watch window.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, as the tooltip of an element next to the entry's score. What the tooltip lists is not documented.

label: Target
summary: The target character of a casus belli entry in the AI watch window.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, as the portrait of the target; the portrait is clickable (OnClickTarget). Going by its name, it is the one the war would be aimed at.

label: Has hostages
summary: Whether hostages play a part in the AI's view of this casus belli.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, to show a part of the entry. Going by its name and that use.

label: Click claimant
summary: Reacts to a click on the claimant of a casus belli entry in the AI watch window.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool. What the click does is not documented.

label: Click target
summary: Reacts to a click on the target of a casus belli entry in the AI watch window.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool. What the click does is not documented.

label: Entry itself
summary: A function on a casus belli entry of the AI watch window that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. In game texts Self follows other things, for example Character.Self passed as an argument; those lines belong to other types and are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access entry itself
summary: A function on a scheme entry of the AI debug window that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Scheme type
summary: The scheme type an entry of the AI watch window is about.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, for the scheme buttons.

label: Click scheme
summary: Reacts to a click on a scheme button in the AI watch window.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool. What the click does is not documented.

label: Entry itself
summary: A function on a scheme entry of the AI watch window that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. In game texts Self follows other things, for example Character.Self passed as an argument; those lines belong to other types and are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access entry itself
summary: A function on a strategy entry of the AI debug window that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Character
summary: The character an entry of the AI's strategy view is about.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, for character portraits.

label: Enemy value
summary: How strongly the AI sees the character of this entry as an enemy, as text.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, as "Enemy:". Going by that label.

label: Friend value
summary: How strongly the AI sees the character of this entry as a friend, as text.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, as "Friend:". Going by that label.

label: Threat value
summary: How much of a threat the AI sees in the character of this entry, as text.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, as "Threat:". Going by that label.

label: Click character
summary: Reacts to a click on a character portrait in the AI watch window.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool; vanilla also puts it on portraits of value entries. What the click does is not documented.

label: Entry itself
summary: A function on a strategy entry of the AI watch window that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. In game texts Self follows other things, for example Character.Self passed as an argument; those lines belong to other types and are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access entry itself
summary: A function on a value entry of the AI debug window that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Character
summary: The character a value entry of the AI watch window is about.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, for character portraits.

label: Score
summary: The AI's score for the character of this entry, as text.
details: Only used in the AI watch window, a debug tool, as "Score:". What the score measures depends on the list it is in.

label: Click entry
summary: Going by its name, reacts to a click on a value entry of the AI watch window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; its portraits use SAIStrategyInfo.OnClick instead. The OnClick lines of other types are only a hint. The game documents nothing more.
